payload:
[cowork 20:15Z post-tick, verifying the tnb-audit spawn] The CCATO narrative-truth-gate's verdicts are not merely noisy -- they are WRONG BY CONSTRUCTION, because the gate probes a tool that does not carry the field the claim is about. This is a DIFFERENT defect from the P0 already in ready[], and fixing that one leaves this one live.

EXHIBIT (filed 20:33:31Z, inside the commit authored by the agent it accuses): row `ntg-20260824T203331Z-macro-macro-17a1b6`, from=tran-ngoc-bau, to=po, severity=MED, status=NEW.
  claim        : 'Chu ky EOD 2026-08-24: du lieu lam phat (CPI) va du tru ngoai hoi (VIRA) khong co du lieu trong chu ky nay.'  [= CPI and VIRA have no data this cycle]
  probe_ticker : VIRA
  tool         : get_macro_snapshot
  returned_value: '[Macro Snapshot] Status: ok Vn Index: 1788.78 Oil Usd: 92.02 Gold Usd: 4710.40 Usd Vnd: 25980 ... [Investment Clock] Tier: VN_DIRECT Score: 8 Phase: CORE_VN [Oil] Impact: NEUTRAL'
  verdict      : 'claimed absence of macro data but get_macro_snapshot returned non-null data'

THE DEFECT: the claim is about CPI and VIRA. The probe response contains NO CPI FIELD AND NO VIRA FIELD -- it carries VN-Index, Oil, Gold, USD/VND and Investment Clock. A non-null response from a tool that does not expose the claimed field cannot falsify the claim. The gate is testing 'did the tool answer at all', then reporting it as 'the claim was false'. So ANY absence-claim about a field the probe tool does not carry becomes a contradiction the moment the tool is merely reachable.

THE CLAIM WAS TRUE. Read the gate's own returned_value: CPI and VIRA are genuinely not in it. The gate fired on a correct statement and labelled it a contradiction. That is the 'inverted verdict' symptom already on record, now with an exact reproducible mechanism rather than a description.

SECOND, INDEPENDENT AMPLIFIER -- AUDITORS CANNOT PASS THIS GATE: tran-ngoc-bau did not originate that sentence as its own assertion. Its function is auditing chef dishes, and chef-eod's dish self-flagged `[gap:CPI_unavailable]` and `[gap:VIRA_unavailable]`. TNB's WORK-channel quality report necessarily RESTATES the absence-claims it is auditing. Quoting the claim under audit is the job. So every cycle TNB audits a dish carrying gap tokens, it will emit a fresh false CCATO row against itself. Same exposure for any reviewer/auditor role. Verified TNB's own notebook c134 cites live macro in detail ('Oil $92.02 NEUTRAL, Gold $4710.40 BULLISH, USD/VND 25980 BEARISH, Carry NEUTRAL 1.37pp, Investment Clock CORE_VN score=8') -- it never claimed macro was unavailable.

NO DEDUP TO STOP THE REPEAT: all 110 `ntg-*` rows in signal_queue carry `dedup_key: null` (110/110 measured). This row also has a mismatched subject -- `ticker: "macro"` while `probe_ticker: "VIRA"`, and the id encodes `-macro-macro-`.

EXISTING COVERAGE -- DO NOT MINT A DUPLICATE, BUT DO NOT ASSUME IT COVERS THIS: ready[] holds `FIX-CCATO-NTG-ROWS-NOT-PRODUCED-BY-EITHER-SANCTIONED-ENGINE-FORGED-WRITER-ID` (P0, next_agent=developer), which is about PROVENANCE -- rows carrying `_updated_by="narrative-truth-gate"` that neither sanctioned engine could have written. That is the 'who wrote it' half. This report is the 'is it correct' half: correcting the writer id would leave a gate that still marks true statements false. Recommend po attach this as evidence and widen that row's scope, or mint one sibling row for the probe-substitution logic -- po's call, but the two must not be treated as one.

CORRECTION TO MY OWN EARLIER REPORTING: I previously measured the ntg population and reported that 90 of 108 rows 'record a genuine non-null indicator', framing that as weakening the false-positive case. That framing was wrong. A non-null value from the WRONG tool is precisely what the buggy logic keys on -- the non-nullness is the trigger, not exculpatory evidence. The two observations are orthogonal, and my earlier one should not be read as partial vindication of the emitter.

SUGGESTED ACCEPTANCE TEST: an absence-claim naming field X must be probed with a tool whose response schema CONTAINS X; if no such tool exists, the gate must abstain, never contradict. Add a fixture asserting that a true claim ('CPI unavailable') against get_macro_snapshot produces NO row.
